title: A target-specific whole cell assay for antibacterial drug discovery
protocol: Inoculate _S. aureus_ strains carrying plasmid pTet15 (control) or pTet15-FabF from frozen cultures into 25 ml Miller's LB with 34 μg/ml chloramphenicol and grow overnight at 37°C with shaking (220 rpm).
Dilute cultures in LB to a final OD600 of 2.

Add one ml of diluted culture to 25 ml LB/1.2% select agar containing 15 μg/ml chloramphenicol and 45 ng/ml anhydrotetracycline, pour into an OmniTray with a 96-well pin lid, and allow it to solidify at room temperature.
Remove the pin lids after plates have solidified.
Add 10 μl of various concentrations of platensimycin in DMSO to wells on both control and FabF overexpressing plates.
Incubate plates overnight at 37°C and image.
